name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.codespace: cd frontend && VITE_API_BASE_URL=/ npm run build && cd .. && concurrently --kill-others -n "backend,frontend" -c "green,cyan" "npm run backend" "cd frontend && __VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS=.app.github.dev npx vite preview --port 3000 --strictPort"
